Finalist of the Best Illusion of the Year Contest 2015

Kokichi Sugihara ”Ambiguous Garage Roof”. Meiji University (Japan)

A round roof of a garage changes its appearance to a corrugated roof when it is reflected in a mirror.  The actual shape is neither round nor corrugated.  This illusory solid was discovered by combining two observations.  One is a mathematical observation that a single image
